name: cinemetric
description: Claude skills for your Plex server. Read-only reports on your media and server, plus mods for Claude Code: a read-only guard and a library status line.

read_only_guard.title: Read-only guard
read_only_guard.description: Stops Claude from running its own commands that would change your Plex server, Tautulli or plex.tv. Only you can switch it off.

library_status_line.title: Library status line
library_status_line.description: Shows your Plex library's size and when Cinemetric last checked it, just above the prompt. Read from snapshots on this computer; never contacts your server.
